source_statement: The notes describe loadable .ko files as dynamic kernel objects, then call them non-kernel components; the neighboring kernel-architecture examples also classify Windows and Linux in ways that are not consistently explained.
review_needed: Clarify whether the material means built-in versus loadable kernel code and which architecture taxonomy is intended. Questions avoid relying on the disputed labels.

source_statement: The notes divide regex operators into basic and extended wildcard sets without specifying the grep mode/escaping rules, and label fgrep as having no wildcard.
review_needed: Separate regex operators from shell globbing and state whether BRE, ERE, or GNU extensions are intended. Questions use only unambiguous anchors and listed grep options.

source_statement: The substitution example labels s/old_word/new_word/gi as case-sensitive.
review_needed: Verify the intended meaning of the i flag for the sed implementation used in class before teaching this example; no question tests this claim.

source_statement: The notes list creation/access/modification timestamps as inode fields and describe a four-part filesystem layout as a general model across examples including NTFS.
review_needed: Clarify timestamp names and qualify the simplified filesystem layout by filesystem type. Questions avoid creation-time semantics and universal-layout claims.

source_statement: The runlevel table maps runlevel 2 and 3 to multi-user.target with different descriptions and marks 4 reserved; later notes present a different mapping.
review_needed: Describe targets directly and qualify any runlevel compatibility mapping by distribution. No question relies on the numeric mapping.

source_statement: The notes say both RPM and YUM are superseded by DNF, while surrounding material continues to use RPM as the package format/low-level tool.
review_needed: Distinguish the high-level dependency manager from the lower-level RPM tool and package format. Questions use that distinction and do not repeat the overbroad wording.

source_statement: The sample /etc/fstab column headings repeat defaults, obscuring the meaning of the final dump and pass fields.
review_needed: Replace the header with the six actual fields and explain the two trailing numeric fields before using the sample as a configuration exercise.

source_statement: The slides give fixed intra-site timing values and a maximum hop count without explaining topology, notification settings, or applicability.
review_needed: Qualify replication timing/topology statements before using them as exact-value questions. The bank tests multi-master replication and KCC purpose, not these timings.

source_statement: The additional-DC checklist gives low fixed CPU/RAM/storage numbers across a wide range of Windows Server versions.
review_needed: Replace these with current, version-specific minimums and workload sizing guidance before using them for deployment planning. No question tests the figures.

source_statement: The best-practice slides say only one DHCP server should exist per network.
review_needed: Clarify that multiple DHCP servers can be deployed when scopes/failover are coordinated. Questions cover DHCP messages, timers, ports, and reservations instead of this rule.

source_statement: The source calls version 2.1.6 the latest and attributes DHCPv6-Shield to Kea.
review_needed: Verify the current Kea release and distinguish server capabilities from network-device protection features before publishing version/feature claims. No question uses these claims.

source_statement: The configuration sets recursion no, but the caption says this enabled the cache manager.
review_needed: Clarify whether the intended lesson is to disable recursion or configure recursive caching. Questions avoid interpreting the contradictory caption.

source_statement: The slide says Default Domain Policy has the highest precedence among all GPOs linked to the domain without qualifying link order or enforcement.
review_needed: Explain GPO link order, enforced links, and inheritance before using this as a general precedence rule. No question tests the stated ranking.

source_statement: The slide says the policy prevents Control.exe from starting, then says users can still access settings by running Control.exe directly.
review_needed: Reconcile the contradictory description and specify the tested Windows versions/policy behavior. No question tests this limitation.

source_statement: The section titled Envelope Information lists From, To, Cc, Bcc, Subject, Date, attachments, and body together.
review_needed: Separate SMTP envelope fields from RFC 5322 message headers and body before using this as a protocol question.
Correct the version typo to the intended Windows Server release before reusing the slide.

source_statement: The slide calls services interactive while describing daemons as noninteractive background programs and says services operate in the background.
review_needed: Clarify whether service refers to a user-facing capability or a background service process. The bank tests concrete systemd actions rather than this definition.

source_statement: One instruction names /etc/system/system although nearby slides identify /etc/systemd/system for custom units.
review_needed: Correct the directory path and keep the unit override instructions consistent.

source_statement: The runlevel-to-target table maps runlevels 2, 3, and 4 to multi-user.target with descriptions that vary by row.
review_needed: Teach the target names directly and qualify runlevel compatibility mappings by distribution. Questions avoid exact numeric mappings.
